sources.entry: Scenario - AI-powered game asset generation trained on your own art style for consistent characters, items, and environments. #freemium

summary.name: Scenario
summary.one_liner: Scenario is a creative production platform for AI image, video, 3D and audio generation, aimed at game asset pipelines, with workflows, agents and an API.
use_cases: generate consistent game characters and item icons
build reusable image and video pipelines for a team
create textures and props inside Blender
train a custom model on brand or game art style
generate explainer visuals and product videos
run generation from code via API or AI assistants
summary.what_it_does: Scenario provides a browser workspace for image, video, 3D and audio generation, with access to a large catalog of models (the page cites 750+ models from 50+ providers). Users can compare models on the same brief and anchor results with references and custom-trained models. Workflows let users chain models and tools on a node canvas, save them as reusable workflows or apps, and run them from a form with cost shown before each run. The page also describes agents (a Node Agent and Genie assistant) that build workflows from a brief, plus MCP and REST API/SDK access for connecting Claude, Codex, Cursor or custom pipelines.
notable: Custom model training on your own art, brand look or recurring characters
Node-based workflows that can be published as apps with cost shown before runs
MCP server and REST API with TypeScript and Python SDKs
Enterprise options: SSO, audit log, per-project spend caps, IP Detection add-on
caveats: Paid plans listed at Starter $10/mo, Pro $30/mo, Max $50/mo (discounted from list prices shown); 50 free daily credits on the free tier
IP Detection is an optional add-on billed separately in credits; Enterprise pricing is custom
